description.narrative: To ensure climate finance is effectively leveraged to reduce global carbon emissions by safeguarding funds from corruption and ensuring they reach intended beneficiaries including those most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change.The TI CGIP programme goals to 2025 are as follows:1.Inclusive climate policies that truly include communities;2.Fair and accountable allocation of climate finance3.Effective delivery of climate projects benefits on the ground; and4.Adequate redress and recovery of misused resources.Countries involved are Australia, Bangladesh, Brazil, Cambodia, Cameroon, Colombia, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, France, Germany, Honduras, Indonesia, Kenya, Lithuania, Madagascar, Malaysia, Maldives, Mauritius, Mozambique, Nepal, Pakistan, Peru, South Africa, Spain, Togo, Uganda, UK, US, Vanuatu, Zambia, and TI EU. Value of the contract is USD 12,000,000.
